title: Manufacturer and EU responsible person on product pages
question: Do product pages name the manufacturer with a postal and an electronic address, and the EU responsible person where the manufacturer is outside the EU?
method: On the sampled product pages, read the manufacturer in Product markup and the visible text after manufacturer wording (Hersteller, manufacturer, fabricant, fabricante, produttore, responsible person, verantwortliche Person, personne responsable and the like). Contact details are an address, email or url on the markup's manufacturer, or an email or postal address within about 400 characters after the wording. Found when every page names a manufacturer with contact details. Review when some pages name one but not every page names one with contact details. Not found when no page names one. The brand is not read as the manufacturer. Whether warnings and safety information are needed depends on the product and is not checked.

title: Discounts show the prior lowest price
question: When a product page shows a reduced price, does it state the lowest price of the previous 30 days?
method: Runs on sampled product pages that show a reduced price: a del, s or strike element with a number in it, or a StrikethroughPrice or ListPrice price type in the markup. Found when every such page states the lowest price of the previous 30 days somewhere in its text (lowest price in the last 30 days, niedrigster Preis der letzten 30 Tage, prix le plus bas des 30 derniers jours, precio más bajo de los últimos 30 días and the like). Review when a page with a reduced price does not. Not applicable when no reduced price is shown. Whether the stated price history is true cannot be checked.

title: Review verification explained
question: When the store shows reviews, does it say how it checks they come from real customers?
method: Runs when the home page or a sampled product page carries reviews (AggregateRating or Review markup, or a known review widget such as Trustpilot, Yotpo or Judge.me). Found when those pages or the terms explain how reviews are checked (verified purchase, verified buyer, how we check reviews, Bewertungen werden geprüft, avis vérifiés). Review when no such statement is found. Not applicable when no reviews are seen.

spec.title: Unfair Commercial Practices Directive 2005/29/EC, Article 7(6) and Annex I
FTC Trade Regulation Rule on Consumer Reviews and Testimonials, 16 CFR Part 465

title: Generic environmental claims
question: Do the pages read make generic environmental claims a reviewer should substantiate?
method: Review when the home page or a sampled product page uses a generic environmental claim (climate neutral, carbon neutral, eco-friendly, environmentally friendly, klimaneutral, umweltfreundlich, CO2-neutral, respectueux de l'environnement, respetuoso con el medio ambiente and the like), and list the first claim on each page with its context. Found (none seen) otherwise. A claim backed by recognised excellent environmental performance or a certification scheme can be lawful, which the scan cannot tell.

spec.title: Directive (EU) 2024/825 on empowering consumers for the green transition

title: Swiss price display
question: Do product pages show prices in Swiss francs with VAT included?
method: Runs when the store appears to sell to Switzerland. On the sampled product pages, found when every page shows a price in CHF (priceCurrency CHF in the markup, or "CHF" or "Fr." before a number) and states that VAT is included (inkl. MWST, TVA incluse, IVA inclusa, incl. VAT). Review when CHF prices are shown but not every page shows a CHF price with the VAT statement. Not found when no page shows a CHF price.
